subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A system with the impulse response h(t) = 6𝛿(t + 5)
 (a)
Has memory and is stable
(b)
Does not have memory and is unstable
(c)
Has memory and is unstable
(d)
None of above

options.text: Does not have memory and is unstable

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-05 (Signal and Systems).
